rounds: Some brands should be allowed to die.
A remake is never as good as the original.
Bands that get back together are only doing it for the money.
It’s better to launch something new than to bring something old back.
My generation will be nostalgic about TikTok one day.
The 2000s were the best decade for fashion.
CDs and cassettes will make a big comeback.
I’d rather buy a classic second-hand than a modern copy new.
